sql:
-- Let me also verify by checking what happens with the per-gap interpretation
-- to see if there's a significant difference
WITH actual_drives AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round
    FROM drives
    WHERE CAST(drive_id AS VARCHAR) != '-1'
),
ordered_drives AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY first_round) as rn
    FROM actual_drives
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT a.year, a.driver_id, a.constructor_id as prev_constructor_id,
           b.first_round as next_first_round, b.constructor_id as next_constructor_id,
           a.last_round + 1 as first_missed_round,
           b.first_round - 1 as last_missed_round,
           b.first_round - a.last_round - 1 as num_missed_races
    FROM ordered_drives a
    JOIN ordered_drives b ON a.year = b.year AND a.driver_id = b.driver_id AND a.rn = b.rn - 1
    WHERE b.first_round > a.last_round + 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_gaps,
    AVG(1.0 * first_missed_round) as avg_first_round_missed,
    AVG(1.0 * last_missed_round) as avg_last_round_missed
FROM gaps
WHERE num_missed_races < 3 AND prev_constructor_id != next_constructor_id
